value.rationale: The hyperbolic Santaló minimization problem motivates balancing two clipping planes of a spherical test body. The theorem demonstrates a nontrivial switch from stable to unstable balanced configurations within a single parent-radius band, in opposite shallow/deep regimes, with two exact independent geometric critical radii. This is a structural obstruction to global two-cap symmetrization, not a small numerical improvement, random arbitrary slice or recomputation of the symmetric formula.
